meta.title: Auto Mouse Mover — Keep Your System Active
meta.description: Automatically simulates mouse movement to prevent your computer from going to sleep or showing as idle. Just keep this tab open and your system stays awake.

howItWorks: The tool simulates small mouse movements at regular intervals.
These movements prevent your operating system from detecting inactivity.
Your system stays active while the tool runs in the browser tab.
howToUse: Click Start to begin automatic mouse movement.
Set the interval (in seconds) between movements if adjustable.
Click Stop when you no longer need the system to stay awake.

faq.question: Is this safe to use?
faq.answer: Yes. The tool only simulates mouse movement within the browser. It does not install any software or modify system settings.

faq.question: Will this work if I close the tab?
faq.answer: No. The mouse mover only works while the browser tab is open and active. Closing the tab stops the simulation.

faq.question: Can I use this to prevent screen lock?
faq.answer: Yes. The simulated movement prevents most systems from triggering screen lock or sleep mode while the tab is open.

examples.title: Prevent idle status
examples.description: Keep your system active during long downloads or processes.
examples.output: Mouse moves every 30 seconds — system stays awake
